name: TwistingData.polyAction_polyOfCoeffs
summary: Expand both sides in monomials; Sym^n(g_s) is by definition the matrix of linSubst g_s on degree-n monomials.

steps.claim: polyOfCoeffs F = Σ_α F(α)·Π_s x_s^{α_s} (x_s^{α_s} the monomial of letter s, renamed into the variables (·, s)); g acts on the letter-s variables by linSubst g_s, which sends a degree-n monomial to a homogeneous form of degree n equal to Σ_β (coefficient)·x^β (sum_monomials_eq_of_isHomogeneous), the coefficients being the entries of Sym^n(g_s); multiplying over s gives the entries of ρ(g), so the image is Σ_β (ρ(g)F)_β x^β = polyOfCoeffs(ρ(g)F).
steps.lean:
simpa [monomial_eq, coeff_map, -univ_eq_attach] using congr(∑ α, F α • ∏ s, rename (·, s)
    $(sum_monomials_eq_of_isHomogeneous ((α s).isHomogeneous_linSubst (T.letterMatrix s g)))).symm
